Subject: FintechCo — Next steps & dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Ethan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: We covered primary use cases (customer support summarization + in-product guidance), expected peak qps ~120 requests/s, median request size ~350 tokens, spikes to ~800 tokens for long transcripts.
- Goal: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing session (dedicated GPU pool sizing + throughput/latency tradeoffs) with our Solutions Engineer (Camila) and your infra lead.
- Proposed agenda for sizing call (30–45m):
  1) Confirm QPS distribution and burst patterns
  2) Target latency SLOs (p95 target, tail budget)
  3) Model family & quantization constraints
  4) Autoscaling and burst capacity approach
  5) Next steps / timeline / procurement touchpoints

Can you share 2–3 windows next week that work for your team? We’ll bring a short throughput calculator and an example config. I’ve attached a quick template for throughput numbers you can fill in beforehand (FintechCo_throughput_estimate.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—Marissa

Hi Ethan — thanks for confirming. Quick note on prep so we can make the session actionable:

- If you can populate the throughput sheet with a representative 24h distribution (median/95th/peak), that will let me pick a realistic baseline and sizing options.
- Please indicate whether p95 latency target is <=250ms or a laxer target; we’ll model both.
- If you have model family preferences (e.g., Llama2-13B vs an open LLM / custom finetune), mention them in the sheet.

I’ll bring: a short throughput calculator, recommended Dedicated GPU pool sizes for the modeled loads, and examples of quantization tradeoffs that affect latency. Plan is to keep it pragmatic and produce 2–3 sizing options we can iterate on post-call.

See you Tue 6/22 10:00 PST.
